summary: Under the 2022 examination regulations, the vocational subject Electrical Engineering totals 39 credits: 21 compulsory credits in Technikdidaktik, including the school practicum, and at least 18 elective credits. Electives may be combined across Elektrische Energiesysteme (both catalogues), Mess-, Steuerungs- und Regelungstechnik, Informations- und Kommunikationstechnik, Elektronik und Photonik, and Übergreifend. Only the two best elective grades count; further elective work is ungraded. The second teaching subject and the Kernstudium are outside this Hauptfach file.

categories.name: Electrical engineering electives
categories.note: In the vocational subject Electrical Engineering, at least 18 credits must be chosen from the specialisations (Elektrische Energiesysteme, Mess-, Steuerungs- und Regelungstechnik, Informations- und Kommunikationstechnik, Elektronik und Photonik, and Übergreifend). Modules may be combined across specialisations. Only the two best grades count; further work is ungraded. The 21 credits of Technikdidaktik, including the school practicum, are compulsory and do not fill this slot.
